resources.string: Boot receivers start this app at boot. Disabling a receiver prevents it. The change is read back from Android. Background execution (RUN_IN_BACKGROUND) is managed in AppOps above.
No boot receiver found in the exposed package dump.
%1$s will be disabled. The app will no longer start at boot through this receiver. The change is read back from Android.
%1$s will be re-enabled. The app can start at boot through this receiver again. The change is read back from Android.
Android returned success but kept the previous state. The system silently ignored this change.
